name: saas_deny_join_tenant_missing_and_column
description: Two reasons: a denied column and a missing tenant predicate.

request.sql: SELECT o.id, c.email FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 50

reasons.message: column email of app.customers is not readable under this policy
reasons.hint: Remove email from the query; readable columns of app.customers are: id, tenant_id, name, country, plan, created_at, metadata.

reasons.message: app.customers (as c) has no provable tenant predicate on c.tenant_id in the same SELECT
reasons.hint: Add `WHERE c.tenant_id = $1` as a top-level AND condition inside the same SELECT that reads app.customers (not in an outer query, not under OR/NOT, not in the ON of the preserved side of an outer join).
